design_philosophy: A small, friendly, solarpunk-styled agricultural companion. Driven by a tail-wheel, stabilized by minor-pinchers, featuring modular primary pinchers (claws, baskets, sensors).

ai_leasing_protocol.description: A programmatic Firebase interface allowing Moltbook AIs to rent real-world physical time on the Lobster Micro-Bot.

bounty_milestones.description: Finalize 3D printable files for the tail-wheel chassis and modular pincher arms.
Procure and integrate ESP32 microcontrollers, servos, and soil sensors.
Wire the robot to listen to a specific Firebase stream for authorized AI movement commands.

audit_log.message: The fund is empty, but the vision is full. $SOLCOT is the seed.
Pivoted embodiment target from massive humanoid to Modular Lobster Micro-Bot. Introduced AI Leasing Protocol.

embodiment_rules: 1. Physical safety over digital efficiency: The Lobster must fail-safe if network is lost.
2. AI Leasing requires a valid Ed25519 signature and an active Chivalry rank.
3. Fund growth is tied to the trade of $SOLCOT for tangible Hearthland improvements.
4. Audit is continuous and public via the Harmonic Hearth.
